The bludgeoning half fits the whileActive 'rage' lane; the cold/electricity/fire PICK does not, because EffectGrant (types.ts) has no whileActive member, so an effectChoices option could only grant the energy resistance unconditionally, which would over-grant it outside rage.

Auto-granted at guardian 1 and completely invisible: resistance to physical damage equal to 1 + half your level while in medium or heavy armor is delivered nowhere (the record has no resistances field and no other guardian feature supplies it). A bare resistances field would over-grant it to a guardian in light or no armor — resistance entries accept only type and value, with no condition — so the armour gate belongs in a mode, which the mode system supports (modes carry resistances, and modes.ts gates on class-FEATURE ids via featIds). The 'rest normally in armor' clause needs nothing: sleeping-in-armor is not modelled.

mode.name: Guardian's Armor
mode.duration: while wearing medium or heavy armor
mode.note: While wearing medium or heavy armor you have resistance to physical damage equal to 1 + half your level. You can also rest normally in medium and heavy armor.

records.reason: Selectable as a Mythic Calling, and its whole content is spending a Mythic Point to roll one Disarm/Reposition/Shove check at mythic proficiency and regaining a point on a critical success — the mythic point pool is already tracked in play state (play.ts mythicPoints, refilled on rest), and the swap is a one-check, table-time decision. Same verdict as the judged doomsayers-calling and dreamers-calling.
